contract.selection: unchanged annotation-exposure-v1 plan; all seven pairs and fourteen 200-frame windows; retain all forty input identities
contract.roles: constant windows are the decision population; change windows and their pre/post strata are descriptive contrasts only
contract.prefix: last four annotated beats strictly before start; anchor is the last; period is their endpoint span divided by three
contract.nominal_period: 60000000 / pre-segment BPM in microseconds, interpreted as an exact decimal rational; not fitted
contract.correspondence: same annotation ordinal since prefix anchor, never nearest tick or phase wrapping; virtual predictions need not lie in the window
contract.decomposition: actual - prefix prediction = first selected beat error + (ordinal - first ordinal) * (nominal period - prefix period) + actual - first actual - (ordinal - first ordinal) * nominal period
contract.phase_term: first selected beat error is an observed alignment offset including accumulated pre-window drift, not an identified physical phase or fitted correction
contract.normalization_bound_us: 1 + ordinal/3 for annotation-minus-prefix error; bounds only independent nearest-microsecond normalization of three distinct timestamps, not upstream annotation precision
contract.ownership: half-open window; compare ordinal sets, preserving annotation-only, continuation-only and uncovered continuation ordinals
contract.query_support: unchanged ceil(center_frames-3)>=0 and floor(center_frames+3)<200, with window membership required
contract.radius: 60000 microseconds inclusive, unchanged descriptive geometric threshold, not a response match or accuracy score
contract.decision: any constant-window ordinal error beyond its normalization bound requires clock-nuisance control before model-discrimination claims; otherwise only no beyond-normalization drift observed, not validation
contract.serialization: exact rational microsecond quantities as strings; counts and identity hashes only, no event arrays or absolute coordinates

upstream_annotation_precision: unknown; normalization bounds are not annotation uncertainty
